title: Novcoat
content:
Novcoat is a French distributor of pigments, additives, and formulation materials. The company has represented aerogel materials in France for coatings and construction-oriented applications.

  • Coverage Area: France and parts of southern Europe
  • Focus Areas: Coatings additives, formulation support, insulation-related additives, and aerogel powders for industrial formulations
  • Current Brands Represented: Svenska Aerogel (Quartzene®)
  • Official Website: https://www.novcoat.fr/
review_notes: 2026-08 verified: former domain lapchem.fr retired; active at novcoat.fr; distributor of Svenska Aerogel Quartzene.
